carriers.description: ARABIAN SEA (Nov. 13, 2026) — A dental tiger team from the Nimitz-class aircraft carrier USS George Washington (CVN 73) embarked on six destroyers during its deployment, providing dental care to more than 600 Sailors – most recently the Arleigh Burke-class guided-missile destroyer USS Shoup (DDG 86), to provide annual dental exams to the crew, supporting operational readiness while ships operate in the U.S. 5th Fleet area of operations.
